g.text: RL-09A: WEST LAKEFRONT ELEVATION — BATTERED BUFF PARAPET & COPPER FASCIA
RL-09B: SOUTH CANTILEVER ELEVATION — HEXAGONAL LAKE PIER & PROW
▲ REDLINE RL-09 · REV P03.1 AS-BUILT FIELD VERIFICATION
WEST & SOUTH ELEVATION REDLINES (VERIFIED TO REFERENCE/02 & 03): Replaced 2-story glass curtain wall with EL +2.92m..+4.48m
Battered Buff-Stucco Cantilever Parapet, EL +4.48m..+7.38m 14-Bay Mahogany Ribbon Windows, and EL +7.28m..+8.32m Battered Copper Fascia.
UNDER-CANTILEVER PIER: Added Hexagonal Desert-Rubblestone Support Pier (EL +0.10m..+2.95m) & Steep Red Boat Gangway at NW Bastion.
